newsitem.title: USA: Jacor to acquire Premiere Radio.
newsitem.headline: Jacor to acquire Premiere Radio.

text.p: Jacor Communications Inc said Monday it has definitively agreed to acquire the outstanding shares of Premiere Radio Networks Inc for cash and stock valued at about $18 per Premiere share.
Jacor said it will pay $13.50 cash and the balance in common stock, adjustable under certain circumstances, for Premiere, a producer and distributor of radio programs.

It said the total consideration including payment for certain Premiere warrants and stock options should be about $185 million. Jacor said net of Premiere's cash-on-hand and excess working capital it will assume, the total consideration is about $165 million.
Jacor shares closed Monday up 3/8 at 28-3/8. Premiere shares closed unchanged at 16.
Earlier Monday, Jacor, which owns, operates or provides programming to about 130 radio stations in the country, had announced its plan to buy NSN Network Services for $11 million in cash and stock.
A news release from Jacor said Premiere, which has 6,300 radio station affiliates under contract, "fits perfectly" with its plans to synergize the complementary businesses of its company.

Jacor said approval of the acquisition by Premiere's shareholders is assured because management shareholders and Archon Communications Inc, Premiere's largest shareholder, have executed agreements to vote in favor of the deal.
It said the merger is expected to close in the summer.
